name: e2e-zh-cn-language-pack
displayName: E2E Simplified Chinese Language Pack (test fixture)
description: Minimal offline stand-in for Microsoft's Simplified Chinese language pack, used only to make VS Code accept `--locale=zh-cn` in E2E tests. Its own translations are empty (VS Code's core UI stays English) — this only needs to exist so `vscode.env.language` resolves to `zh-cn`, which is all GitLens' own l10n catalog selection depends on.
